notes.title: Cast & Spell is out in early access!
notes.content:
🎁Our new game is available now! Thank you all for your support.

👀Play, enjoy, leave feedback, and submit bug reports! 

🫵Remember, the game is still in development, and its future depends on you!

[b]https://discord.com/invite/NzHFTfHrXh[/b]

notes.title: 📣We are releasing a new game‼️
notes.content:
Thanks for your support! Our new game, [b]Cast & Spell[/b], will be released soon, so we're sharing this news with you! 

Many of you have been waiting for new content for a long time, but we decided to concentrate on creating a new game. Those who followed us on our Discord channel knew this for a long time and could follow the development process. Now, the development process is gradually coming to an end, and we decided to inform you about it. We hope that the new game will bring you no less fun! Add a new game to your wishlist if you don’t want to miss a release!

🔴 [b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.com/invite/NzHFTfHrXh

🔴 [b]Cast & Spell steam page:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/app/3032020/Cast__Spell/

See you in the new game! We look forward to your support!

notes.title: 🔥Emotions have been added to the game!
notes.content:
💥Now your time in the game will be even more fun thanks to dancing!

🤟🏽Press buttons 3 or 4 on your keyboard or customize the buttons in settings.

notes.title: 👀Field of view setting added!
notes.content:
🔔You've been asking for a long time to add the ability to change the construction field, and now it's possible!

📢Now you can change the viewing angle in the settings from 70 to 120 degrees!

notes.title: Food and Christmas update!
notes.content:
😍Thank you everyone for your support and waiting!

🎅🏼We are pleased to bring you the [b]Christmas and Food update[/b]. Now you can save money and buy yourself food to become stronger and faster! 

🎁Don't forget to open your [b]Christmas gifts[/b], you deserve them!

🍅If your goal is not to win, but to relax with friends, you can get food without effects for free!

🍟Enjoy the game and report any bugs to us! [b]Merry Christmas[/b]!

notes.title: Server list update!
notes.content:
We have received many messages that you cannot find your friends' servers.
We found out that the problem was in sorting the servers by the number of players.

🔸We have fixed this and you will now see all servers, but they will not be sorted for now as we are still working on this issue.

notes.title: Let there be food and drinks!
notes.content:
🥪Thank you everyone for so many reviews! We saw your desires and are sharing with you future plans for adding food and drink to the game!

🥩What options will food and drink provide?
You can buy whatever you want with the money you earn in minigames and receive effects that will temporarily affect your characteristics! Each food and drink will have different effects!

🥂How long will it take?
We will try to do everything as quickly as possible! We predict this may take several weeks.

notes.title: Soak & Splash is now in Early Access!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that Soak & Splash, our thrilling sauna-themed game, has officially launched in Early Access, and we invite you to jump right in!

🎮 What's Soak & Splash all about?
The game is an ultimate sauna experience where players can enjoy socializing with friends and strangers that easily can become friends. It's all about having fun, relaxing, and experiencing the unique benefits of sauna culture.

🚀 Why Early Access?
The game is in early access because it is not yet fully completed, and we would greatly appreciate feedback from players to make the game better on release.

📢 Join the Soak & Splash Community:
Connect with fellow players, share your experiences, and stay updated on the latest developments by joining our official Discord server and following us on social media.

🔗 Discord: discord.gg/NzHFTfHrXh
📸 TikTok: tiktok.com/@soakandsplash

Don't miss out on the sauna adventure! Grab your gear and make a splash in Soak & Splash's Early Access today! 🌊💧
